title: Fresh 4% Paraformaldehyde in PBS
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Fresh 4% Paraformaldehyde in PBS for Perfusion
EQ0006 pH Meter Calibration and Usage
Verify that the pH meter is calibrated.

steps.title: Record reagent details
steps.instruction: Enter all lot numbers, reagent names, and volumes used into the reagent preparation notebook.

steps.title: Weigh PFA powder
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, weigh 42 g of paraformaldehyde (PFA) powder, avoiding inhalation and cleaning any spills immediately.

steps.title: Dissolve PFA in water
steps.instruction: Add the 42 g PFA to 500 mL Milli‑Q water in a glass Pyrex bottle (minimum 750 mL capacity). Add 1 mL of 5 M NaOH, place a magnetic stir bar in the bottle, set the stir plate to medium speed, and set the plate temperature to 65 °C.

steps.title: Heat and stir solution
steps.instruction: Stir and heat the mixture at 65 °C for approximately 30 minutes until the solution becomes clear or nearly clear, indicating complete dissolution of PFA.

steps.title: Add PBS and water
steps.instruction: Add 100 mL of 10× PBS to the clear solution, then add Milli‑Q water up to the 1 L mark (≈ 400 mL).

steps.title: Cool to handling temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the bottle to cool in the hood until it reaches ~20–27 °C (hand‑warmable). Do not attempt to pH‑adjust a hot solution.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 7.4
steps.instruction: While stirring, add HCl dropwise with a transfer pipette until the pH reads 7.4 at room temperature. If the pH overshoots, do not back‑adjust with base; instead, remake the solution.

steps.title: Remove stir bar
steps.instruction: When the correct pH is attained, remove the magnetic stir bar using a stir‑bar remover.

steps.title: Filter solution
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, set up the Corning 500 mL filter system with a 0.45 µm filter (0.22 µm acceptable if 0.45 µm unavailable). Connect Tygon tubing from the filter housing to a 500 mL filter flask, then connect the flask to the Gast vacuum pump located outside the hood and turn the pump on.

substeps.instruction: Filter 500 mL of solution at a time, keeping the remaining solution stirring on the plate.
Use a fresh filter system for each 500 mL batch.

steps.title: Label and store solution
steps.instruction: Label the bottle “4 % PFA in 1X PBS” with the preparation date and your initials. Store the solution at 4 °C; it may be used for up to 7 days. Do not freeze.

steps.title: Dispose waste and clean bottle
steps.instruction: Dispose any unused PFA in the designated PFA waste barrel and discard the filtration container in regular non‑hazardous waste. Rinse the glass bottle thoroughly with de‑ionized water, air‑dry (no soap), and store it for future use.

steps.title: Manage PFA waste containers
steps.instruction: Empty all waste containers or Tecan reservoirs containing 4 % PFA into the PFA waste barrel daily; arrange for off‑site disposal of full barrels according to contracted waste‑management procedures.
